metadata.description: AI-augmented research workflow plugins for the African Research Group for Oncology. Built around REDCap as the system of record for multi-site oncology cohorts.

plugins.name: argo-core
plugins.description: Shared REDCap API conventions and reference material. Required by the other ARGO plugins.

plugins.name: argo-pm
plugins.description: Project management for admins (PMs set up and track; they don't build). Draft the new-study document package to relieve the PM bottleneck (study-setup) and get a weekly view across admin REDCaps that surfaces unbuilt studies (study-portfolio).

plugins.name: argo-build
plugins.description: Build, audit, and administer REDCap studies. Triage a submitted study request and assess build-readiness (study-intake), construct or audit the data dictionary (redcap-build), and manage user rights and roles on live projects (redcap-admin).

plugins.name: argo-qa
plugins.description: Continuous data quality assurance for active REDCap cohorts. Branching-logic-aware completeness worklists per site (per-DAG) for RAs to resolve.

plugins.name: argo-data
plugins.description: Data management — the token-holding role. Export/import REDCap records, metadata, files, and audit logs (data-export), and link records across studies/sources with safe diff-only write-back (study-linkage).

plugins.name: argo-analysis
plugins.description: Analysis on a local REDCap export — no API token needed. Interview-driven analysis plan, saved well-commented scripts, and organized, auditable outputs (run-analysis).
